scope: I05 bounded ROC-only standalone study. No MACD, ladder, live/config/state changes, or indicator/HL/SR combinations.
formula: Unrounded simple percent return: 100 * (current closed price / price N closed bars ago - 1). N=1,5,12; first valid after N+1 contiguous closed prices. Positive unbounded, negative strictly greater than -100 for positive prices; zero is valid. No EMA, RSI, CRSI, ATR normalization or volume/pulse input.

entryRules.momentum: Long previous ROC <= +M and current > +M; short previous >= -M and current < -M. M=0,1,2,4. Zero crossings repeat original I01 ROC5 at 1h.
entryRules.into: Contrarian long previous ROC > -M and current <= -M; short previous < +M and current >= +M. M=1,2,4; no zero duplicate.
entryRules.back_out: Recovery long previous <= -M and current > -M; short previous >= +M and current < +M. M=1,2,4; a rolling-denominator change alone can trigger a crossing.

exitRules: Fixed12h from actual fill, or first subsequent completed ROC zero condition capped at12h. Momentum: long <=0 / short >=0 (loss of momentum, including zero). Contrarian into/back_out: long >=0 / short <=0 (normalization). Never use entry-time feature as immediate exit; timeout priority; pending exits immutable.
timing: Fixed June1 seed, finalized contiguous UTC bars only; signal at bar end, subsequent minute-open execution with modeled0 publication lag or +1m every entry and exit. No execution-minute high/low/close at entry, no forming bars, no reseed, no synthetic start-state entry.
inventory: One independent fixed-notional position per rule, no adds/compounding. Occupied/pending signals skipped; fresh crossing after exit. Close then entry ordering. Cutoff position marked with estimated exit fee, not a completed trade.
funding: Excluded: complete settlement archive unavailable. Trading fees included, no margin/liquidation/queue/slippage-path or historical receipt-time certification. No API/order actions.
researchScreen: Same I01/I04 strict diagnostic: >=30full/10recent closes in both delays, positive net and positive same-side clock delta in allfour, no negative monthly marked delta beyond 1e-8, positive extra5bps/side net, solvent. Preserve all failures; not blanket ROC rejection.
ranking: All600 descending full0m delta versus own-side clock; additionally side-specific absolute-net rankings. Predeclared descriptive subset requires sample, positive net/stress, solvency in allfour; rank by full0m absolute net, show top5 if nonempty else raw top5 with sample caveats. Subset does not replace strict screen.
exitComparison: Every indicator_or12h versus identical entry fixed12h, full path reruns; no mixing exits/thresholds after results.
reporting: Exact dates, $10k/$32k assumptions, baseline W/L counts/dollars, open/net/DD, both delays/costs, monthly top5 deltas, per-timeframe/lookback/mode scarcity, selected worst MAE and winner concentration. Causal trace includes denominator timestamps/prices and previous/current ROC.
overlapParity: Original hourly ROC5 zero-cross side/exit rules plus clocks across two windows and delays:24 old/new/saved stat/month/ledger checks before new results. Added ROC/lag provenance may be stripped for legacy-ledger identity only, and ROC5 equality must be independently asserted.
limitations: 600 correlated mined definitions, not600 independent discoveries. Windows overlap; not untouched holdout. No alternative lags beyond1/5/12, 0.5% or8% thresholds, acceleration/divergence, persistence, logarithmic/vol-normalized ROC, daily, TP/SL/partials, indicator/HL/SR combos or ladder/portfolio certification.
writes: New local output directory only, fail if it exists. Frozen source/card preserved. Findings/register updates after independent verification; no live changes or commit/push.
